notes: Ranges may only ever be tightened, never widened: the hardware limits in the ObjectIR remain authoritative. The overlay is found by the object's name, so every build of this G1 gets it. Each range stops where a pose stops reading as natural, not only where the body would break.

left_elbow_joint.guards: Backward (hyperextended) elbow; about 80 deg is a straight arm, larger values bend the forearm behind the upper arm

right_elbow_joint.guards: Backward (hyperextended) elbow; about 80 deg is a straight arm, larger values bend the forearm behind the upper arm

left_hip_pitch_joint.guards: Leg swung backwards past a natural stride (positive is extension); forward flexion beyond a deep squat

right_hip_pitch_joint.guards: Leg swung backwards past a natural stride (positive is extension); forward flexion beyond a deep squat

left_hip_roll_joint.guards: Leg abducted into a split or crossed far over the other leg

right_hip_roll_joint.guards: Leg abducted into a split or crossed far over the other leg

left_hip_yaw_joint.guards: Foot turned out or in past a natural stance

right_hip_yaw_joint.guards: Foot turned out or in past a natural stance

waist_yaw_joint.guards: Torso twisted past a natural rotation on the pelvis

left_shoulder_pitch_joint.guards: Arm swung backwards and up behind the body

left_shoulder_yaw_joint.guards: Upper arm twisted until the forearm points backwards

left_wrist_yaw_joint.guards: Hand bent sideways past natural wrist deviation

right_shoulder_pitch_joint.guards: Arm swung backwards and up behind the body

right_shoulder_yaw_joint.guards: Upper arm twisted until the forearm points backwards

right_wrist_yaw_joint.guards: Hand bent sideways past natural wrist deviation
